study type: Pilot study, single group, pre/post-intervention design
outcome: Intention to use a method of birth control other than condoms
cohort: The study included 51 inpatients (mean age = 15.3; 61% female; 57% Hispanic or Latino; 55% heterosexual) receiving inpatient psychiatric care.
finding: The online sexual health education program was feasible to administer and highly acceptable to both youth participants and nursing staff, and led to significant short-term improvements in several psychosocial outcomes among youth.
followup_time: Short-term (outcomes assessed immediately post-intervention for most measures; intention for birth control use assessed for the 'next 3 months')
